reference.criterion: Learners can ordinarily obtain educational content through wireless Internet access.
reference.rationale: iTunes U distributed university material in 2007; contemporary wireless access and connected portable computers supplied the delivery route. This is an availability/distribution claim, not a claim that every course or school has discarded physical books.

evidence.title: Apple: iTunes U opens on the iTunes Store
evidence.note: Free lectures and educational material from major universities; Wi-Fi-capable computers establish wireless access but not wireless prevalence at every school..
